# Migration Intentions - v1.5.0

## Intentions

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:begin — generated by `pnpm boilerplate intentions sync`, do not edit -->

- [`00-node-24-22-2.md`](./00-node-24-22-2.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — The project builds, tests and runs on Node.js 24.22.2 or a later 24 release.
- [`01-install-lefthook-hooks.md`](./01-install-lefthook-hooks.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — `pnpm install` installs the lefthook git hooks, so the commit-msg and pre-push checks run on every clone without a manual step.
- [`02-ci-fmt-check-quiet-hooks.md`](./02-ci-fmt-check-quiet-hooks.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — CI fails when files are not formatted, and the lefthook hooks print only failures, without colors.
- [`03-format-at-commit.md`](./03-format-at-commit.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — A pre-commit hook formats the staged files with Oxfmt, and a commit fails when lefthook is not installed in the worktree. — requires `v1.5.0/install-lefthook-hooks`, `v1.5.0/ci-fmt-check-quiet-hooks`
- [`04-lint-pr-local-description.md`](./04-lint-pr-local-description.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — `pnpm lint:pr --title "<title>" --body-file <file>` runs the CI checks on a title and a description that are not on GitHub yet, and the contributor docs say to run it before `gh pr create`. — requires `v1.1.0/adopt-conventional-commits`
- [`05-one-source-agent-instructions.md`](./05-one-source-agent-instructions.md) — `migration` · `docker-env` — `docker-compose.yml` has no fixed `container_name`, and `CLAUDE.md` holds only the line `@AGENTS.md`.
- [`06-worktree-commands.md`](./06-worktree-commands.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — `pnpm worktree:create <name>` makes a worktree with its own `COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME` and free ports, `pnpm worktree:remove <name>` stops only that worktree's Docker stack before it removes the worktree, and `AGENTS.md` tells agents to use them.
- [`07-interface-prefix-rule.md`](./07-interface-prefix-rule.md) — `migration` · `tooling` — The project guide states one rule for interface and type names: PascalCase, with no `I` prefix, except for a contract that has several implementations.
- [`08-drop-docs-deploy-without-pages.md`](./08-drop-docs-deploy-without-pages.md) — `migration` · `ci` — A project that does not publish its documentation on GitHub Pages has no `.github/workflows/deploy-docs.yml`. The documentation app stays.
- [`09-backend-guide-transactions-seeders-tests.md`](./09-backend-guide-transactions-seeders-tests.md) — `migration` · `api` — The project's backend guide (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/references/backend.mdx`) no longer says that a controller request runs in a transaction, and it carries the rules for transactions, collections, seeders and test data.
- [`10-backend-guide-query-object-no-raw-sql-join-tables.md`](./10-backend-guide-query-object-no-raw-sql-join-tables.md) — `migration` · `api` — The project's backend guide (`apps/documentation/src/content/docs/references/backend.mdx`) carries three rules: use one `@TypedQueryObject(schema)` instead of many `@TypedQuery` decorators, use the MikroORM QueryBuilder or EntityManager instead of raw SQL, and do not create a service for a simple join table. — requires `v1.5.0/backend-guide-transactions-seeders-tests`
- [`11-adopt-feature-query-hooks.md`](./11-adopt-feature-query-hooks.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — Each feature that reads or writes the API through TanStack Query has one file, `hooks/use-<feature>.ts`. That file owns the key factory and one hook per query and per mutation. Components call the hooks. They do not call the generated SDK, and they do not write a query key.
- [`12-compose-page-shells.md`](./12-compose-page-shells.md) — `migration` · `frontend` — A route layout writes its header, its main, and its footer. A screen uses `Page` and `PageHeader`. A block inside a screen uses `Section` and `SectionHeader`. A paged list composes `Pagination`. Pages do not copy the header markup, and they do not pass that chrome in as props.
- [`13-s3-file-storage.md`](./13-s3-file-storage.md) — `informational` · `storage` — Let an existing project know that the boilerplate now ships an opt-in S3 file storage layer, so a human can decide whether to adopt it.

<!-- boilerstone:intentions:end -->
